current_f2_observation.scope: Held-out WORLD-MODEL-PREDICTION benchmark over exact public ObservationView values plus immutable policy state/config; evaluator-only MicroWorldFixture hidden state must never enter policy input; preserve UNKNOWN/abstain; compare public-information baselines; repository component CI only.

observed_mechanism: Env.step returns the next observation after the action.
The info dictionary is auxiliary diagnostic information and may contain variables hidden from observations.
primary_sources.transferable_invariant: WP803 must never pass a raw evaluator/env info mapping into the prediction policy. Policy input should be constructed from an explicit public ObservationView whitelist and sealed independently from evaluator-private state.
primary_sources.caveat: Gymnasium defines a general API, not the F2 benchmark semantics.

primary_sources.source: Dawid 1984, Statistical Theory: The Prequential Approach
observed_mechanism: Predictive quality is evaluated sequentially from forecasts for future observations and the observations that subsequently materialize.
primary_sources.transferable_invariant: WP803 should seal prediction identity before the canonical evaluator advances the episode, then score only against the subsequently observed public outcome. Evaluation-time future information must not influence the forecast.

primary_sources.source: Geifman and El-Yaniv 2017, Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
observed_mechanism: Selective prediction trades prediction risk against coverage by rejecting/abstaining on some inputs.
primary_sources.transferable_invariant: UNKNOWN/abstain cannot be summarized as ordinary accuracy alone. WP803 should report coverage together with selective risk so an always-abstain policy cannot appear artificially strong.

primary_sources.source: Gneiting and Raftery 2007, Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
observed_mechanism: Strictly proper scoring rules assess probabilistic forecasts while incentivizing the forecast distribution to reflect the forecaster's actual predictive distribution.
primary_sources.transferable_invariant: If WP803 later admits probabilistic categorical predictions, use a strictly proper score such as Brier/log score as an optional measurement; do not fabricate probabilities for point-prediction-only policies.

observed_mechanism: Procedurally generated environment distributions are used to measure generalization rather than performance on only memorized environments.
primary_sources.transferable_invariant: Held-out WP803 evaluation should bind fixture-family/split identity and prohibit fitting empirical baselines on the held-out fixture family. Baselines trained from public transitions must have a separate fit-split digest.

primary_sources.source: Kaelbling, Littman and Cassandra 1998, Planning and acting in partially observable stochastic domains
observed_mechanism: Partially observable domains distinguish underlying state from the information available to the agent.
primary_sources.transferable_invariant: Hidden evaluator state may determine the next observation without being valid policy input; inability to infer that hidden state from public history is legitimate uncertainty and should remain UNKNOWN rather than be scored as a forced guess.

supported: Create a hard public/evaluator-private data-plane boundary; raw info/debug/fixture state is evaluator-only.
Seal prediction before environment advancement and score after advancement against the realized public observation.
Report abstention coverage and selective risk together.
Bind held-out fixture-family/split identity and baseline-fit split identity separately.
Use proper probabilistic scoring only when the policy genuinely emits a probability distribution.
not_supported_by_sources_alone: That next-observation prediction is a sufficient measure of general world-model quality.
That any particular score threshold proves cognition, causality, transfer or whole-system quality.
That hidden-state reconstruction should be required when the public history is non-identifying.

counterhypothesis: The existing WP803 scope may already prevent practical leakage and benchmark gaming, so the proposed additions may add schema/test complexity without changing observed behavior. Falsify this by implementing minimal adversarial tests: hidden info injection, fit-split contamination, and always-abstain. If current code already fails closed and reports coverage, no architecture expansion is warranted.
